t: Command-Line Surgery: A Live Refactor to Untangle a Codebase
s: This article details a live, command-line-driven refactoring of the Pipulate codebase to resolve conceptual overlap between its extensibility systems. The author uses tools like `ripgrep` and `sed` to rename directories from `plugins/` and `modules/` to `apps/` and `imports/`, respectively, for improved clarity and maintainability.
